answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a distinct liquidity ridge in a shared collateral manifold, so duplicate wallets collapse onto one ridge and forfeit independent standing. During multi-unit auctions, a mesa-shaped bid landscape reveals collusive clusters, and any agent seeking a safe haven by spawning aliases must post escalating. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
